intro: Technology leads the sectors affected by zero-day activity covered across 39 articles published between 2026-04-12 and 2026-10-20, alongside government, enterprise, healthcare, and telecommunications. APT29, Chaotic Eclipse, and Claude Mythos appear among the top threat actors. The most severe flaw is CVE-2026-22679 at CVSS 9.8, followed by CVE-2026-108398, CVE-2026-92707, and CVE-2026-96951 at CVSS 8.8, and CVE-2026-34621 at CVSS 8.6. Affected regions span Global, Asia, Brazil, China, and Europe, and the severity mix comprises 20 high, 17 critical, and 1 medium.
